description: Train the adaptive cognitive filter: record a False Positive (FP → AI_VETOED) or True Positive (TP → CONFIRMED_TP) for a static hint fingerprint_hash from runsec-semantic-brief.json. After two FP vetoes the finding is auto-suppressed on future scans.

fingerprint_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint from static_hints[].fingerprint_hash in the semantic brief.

reason.description: Optional rationale stored with the feedback entry.

verdict.description: FP = agent vetoed false positive; TP = confirmed true positive.

name: report_cognitive_feedback
